Shared input loader validates target conversion; numerical aggregation and analytical event calculation are separate from producer functions.
Disclosure feasibility is independently checked by existing literal witness validator; endpoint optimality uses saved closed solver bounds.

data_counts.unit: criterion instances and evaluation units, as named

complete_disagreement_endpoint.source: data/reference/judgmentbench (fixed full-target reference and both saved judge vectors)
complete_disagreement_endpoint.selector: JB GPT-5.4 full; all slots where GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4-mini disagree
complete_disagreement_endpoint.warning: Illustrative complete-set endpoint, not an average over new tasks or an adjudication of reference truth.

false_fail_diagnostics.source: data/reference/judgmentbench; original annotation-specific saved judge vectors
false_fail_diagnostics.selector: JB GPT-5.4 full; initial reference-PASS, judge-FAIL annotations; original query population retained
false_fail_diagnostics.warning: Retrospective diagnostics. Peer categories retain annotation weighting and are not truth adjudication. No unit is deleted or reweighted. Item instances share outputs and are not independent observations.

rq1.selector: release order, disagreement_then_random; observed means use seeds 1 through 31

task_order_comparison.definition: 31-realization mean differences; three task orders; query randomization, not composition uncertainty.

expected_loss_break_even.unit: false-PASS cost divided by false-FAIL cost
expected_loss_break_even.condition: For c_FF > 0 and expected A > 0, gating has lower expected endpoint loss iff c_FP/c_FF > E[D]/E[A].
expected_loss_break_even.warning: Conditional on the fixed full JudgmentBench frame and disagreement-then-random priorities; ratios are computed before rounding.

coding_supplement.scope: 399 whole-base-task resamples with fixed original references; no repeated-reference AC panel or independent external test.

fixed_verdict_counterexample.scope: Constructed query-only comparison, not a constrained empirical permutation.

discovery_vs_certification.selector: release order; 20% cap; seeds 1 through 31; short circuit judge-first versus disagreement continuation

pure_certification_endpoints.selector: sc_judge, release order, 20% cap, seeds 1 through 31
pure_certification_endpoints.unit: actual queries and separate marginal median task counts
pure_certification_endpoints.warning: These selective queries have no subsequent probability sample. The stored logical agreement bounds are not a 95% sampling interval or a design-unbiased point estimate.

matched_marginal_configurations.unit: errors over fixed simulated label configurations; not a reversal probability
matched_marginal_configurations.amplitude_note: A one-unit magnitude threshold describes size, not statistical significance or a pre-specified practical threshold.

full_jb_reference_pass_range.warning: Range of the saved 64 reference rearrangements, not extrema over every feasible configuration.

rq2.unit: paired mix minus SRS counts; width in percentage points
rq2.warning: Separate marginal medians need not describe any one run; their ratios are not paired relative effects.

nine_cell_summary.warning: Cell means describe the fixed frames; cells share tasks and are not independent replications. Order MCSE is not task-population uncertainty.

reference_sensitivity.unit: output-level frozen judge comparison, counts or errors per 100 outputs as named

original_repeated_peer_diagnostics.definition: Peers share output_id and have a different human rater_id; current judge prediction is always the original annotation-specific saved draw. Any/all summaries condition on the stated original annotation group; pairs and criterion comparisons have different denominators. Binary criterion agreement uses the declared full/binary-only target. No true-label error rate is identified.

reference_sensitivity.warning: A and B are symmetric hash-selected references. Off-diagonal cells freeze acquisition reference and reevaluate; diagonal cells rerun acquisition.

cluster_sensitivity.unit: errors per 100 evaluation units; empirical 2.5%, 50%, 97.5% task-composition quantiles
cluster_sensitivity.warning: 399 base-task composition resamples; labels and rater population stay fixed. These are sensitivity ranges, not an unqualified new-population confidence claim.

estimation.warning: Historical empirical RMSE is retained as a Monte Carlo diagnostic. Main 20% precision claims use design_rmse below. Guaranteed and approximate intervals have different coverage guarantees.

design_rmse.unit: RMSE fractions in rows; percentage changes in ranges
design_rmse.warning: Exact finite-sum design risks for SRS and strata. Mix averages exact conditional variances over 31 first stages; rmse_mcse is a delta-method Monte Carlo SE, not a confidence interval or reference uncertainty. Allocation code is reused; tests independently enumerate sampling identities.

whole_task_sampling.selector: requested_task_share=0.2; costs are separate marginal medians over seeds 1 through 31
whole_task_sampling.unit: label queries and task-pass percentage points
whole_task_sampling.warning: Same sampled task set and pass estimator; different realized label costs. This is not an equal-label-budget comparison.

disclosure.warning: Direct endpoint feasibility; global optimality additionally uses the original solver's closed objective bounds and exhaustive small-world tests.
